sentences.text: CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE M.NAGAPRASANNA  ORAL ORDER

The petitioners are before this Court calling in question proceedings in C.C.No.9488/2022, pending before the XLI Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Bengaluru, for the offences under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 read with Section 34 of Indian Penal Code and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. Heard Sri.Kapil Dixit, learned counsel appearing for the petitioners, Sri.B.N.Jagadeesha, learned Addl.
SPP appearing for respondent No.1, Sri.Chetan Desai, learned counsel appearing for respondent No.2 and have perused the material on record.
3. The parties to the lis were also before the Family Court in M.C.No.5453/2021 and have settled the dispute amongst themselves before the Family Court by terms of settlement.
One of the term of the settlement is, closure of the present proceedings.

The said Memorandum of Settlement reads as follows:
NC: 2026:KHC:13323 HC-KAR "MEMORANDUM OF SETTLEMENT UNDER SECTION 89 OF CPC READ WITH RULES 24 AND 25 OF THE KARNATAKA CIVIL PROCEDURE (MEDIATION) RULES, 2005.
The parties above named submit as follows:-
I.
The petitioner has filed this petition under Section 13 (1) (i) & (i-a) of the Hindu Marriage Act 1955 for a decree of divorce against the respondent.

II. The petitioner and the respondent state that they are Hindus by religion and their marriage was solemnized on 13.12.2017 at Bandhan Banquet Hall, AC 93, Prafulla Kanan Road, East,
Rabindrapally, Kestopur, Kolkata, West Bengal 700 101 as per Hindu rites and customs and the same was registered before the Marriage Officer, Kolkata, West Bengal vide marriage certificate No.91/2017 dated 13.12.2017.
After their marriage both the parties are residing at Bengaluru within the jurisdiction of this Hon'ble Court.
III. The aforesaid case was referred for mediation for resolving the dispute between the parties.

During the course of mediation, the parties along with their respective counsel were present an identified each other and have resolved their dispute on th following terms and conditions:
1) Due to irreconcilable differences and incompatibility of temperaments, the petitioner and the respondent state that they are living separately from August 2021.

The efforts made by the elders, friends and well-wishers to resolve the differences Arita Banerjee vs State Of Karnataka on 4 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/197453277/
3 between the parties did not yield any fruit.

4) The Petitioner has come up with onetime settlement by paying a sum of Rs.14,00,000/- (Rupees Fourteen Eight Lakhs Only) towards permanent alimony and maintenance of the Respondent.

The Petitioner has already handed over a demand draft for a sum of Rs.8,00,000/- (Rupees Eight Lakhs Only) bearing No.509078 dated 27.11.2025 drawn on ICICI Bank, International Tech Park Branch,
Bengaluru, the respondent herewith acknowledges receipt of the same.

The balance of Rs.6,00,000/- (Rupees Six Lakhs Only) the petitioner undertakes to obtained a demand draft in the name of the respondent for and handed over to the respondent before this Hon'ble Court at the time of recording of this case on 05.12.2025.
The respondent has agreed for the same.

5) The Respondent has filed a Criminal Complaint against the Petitioner under section 498A, 504,
506 323, R/w Section 34 of IPC and Section 3 & 4 of D.P.Act before the Belandur police and the same has been charge sheeted bearing No.C.C.No.9488/2022 pending before 41st ACMM,
Bengaluru.
Against this the Respondent has filed a Writ Petition before the Hon'ble High Court of Karnataka bearing W.P.No.10069/2025 which is pending.
The Respondent hereby undertakes to co- operate in closing the case bearing C.C.No.9488/2022 and W.P.No.10069/2025.

6) There is an order of interim maintenance in this case, in pursuance to which the Respondent has filed execution for recovery of dues bearing Execution No.127/2023 pending before this Hon'ble Court.
Against this order the Petitioner has filed a writ petition bearing W.P.No.16448/2023 pending before the Hon'ble High Court of Karnataka.

The Respondent hereby undertakes to withdraw the execution case bearing Execution No.127/2023 and the Petitioner hereby undertakes to withdraw writ petition bearing W.P.No.16448/2023.
7)
Both the parties state that apart from the above cases there are no other cases filed or pending amongst the parties.
